question.prompt: What exact center content should replace "$24.8M TOTAL" when a segment is selected?

options.label: Asset class only
options.detail: Author the oracle to require the selected asset class name in the center, without asserting percentage or value.

options.label: Class + percent + value
options.detail: Require the center to show the selected asset class together with its percentage and value.

options.label: Provide source
options.detail: Add a source that states the exact selected-allocation center content.

content.risk_rationale: The selected-allocation center state is part of the feature’s core focus behavior; without exact expected content, later tests can prove only that the default center changed, not that the right allocation details were shown.
